content: अभिभवः .²1 Defeat, subjugation, subjection, overpowering; इतरेतरानभिभवेन मृगास्तमुपासते गुरुमिवान्तसदः <ls>Ki. 6. 34</ls> (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>K. 45</ls> and the Bible “The wolf shall also dwell with the lamb” <ab>&c.</ab>); <ls n="Ki.">8. 28</ls>; स्पर्शानुकूला इव सूर्यकान्तास्तदन्यतेजोऽभिभवाद्वमन्ति <ls>Ś. 2. 7</ls> when assailed, opposed, overpowered by another energy; अभिभवः कुत एव सपत्नजः <ls>R. 9. 4</ls>, <ls n="R.">4. 21</ls>. .²2 Being overpowered जराभिभवविच्छायम् <ls>K. 346</ls>; being attacked or affected, stupefied (by fever <ab>&c.</ab>); न रोगशान्तिर्न चाभिभवः <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²3 Contempt, disrespect; निरभिभवसाराः परकथाः <ls>Bh. 2. 64</ls>. .²4 Humiliation, mortification (of pride); अलभ्यशोकाभिभवेयमाकृतिः <ls>Ku. 5. 43</ls>; <ls>K. 195</ls>. .²5 Predominance, prevalence, rise, spread; अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः <ls>Bg. 1. 41</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 37</ls>.
